agentic_insight.summary: Statistical prediction for a Wednesday is 146 items [1]. The agent forecasts 169 (+16%), a lift of about 23 items, all from the Valkyries game. Tavily shows two events tonight: Valkyries vs Aces at Chase Center, 18:30, 0.9 mi away [2], and Rod Wave at 20:00 [3]. Rod Wave's listing is at Oakland Arena, 9.1 mi away. Mem0 recalls the Valkyries' recent playoff nights: <<2026-10-02|Oct 2>> +11% and the semifinal opener <<2026-10-04|Oct 4>> +17% [4]. The agent treats +87% on <<2026-09-27|Sep 27>> as a Giants day-game effect, not a Valkyries one. Why a lift near +16%: a playoff semifinal crowd arrives early, so sales build from about 15:30 and peak 17:30 to 18:30. Why Rod Wave adds almost nothing: it is across the bay and the two events do not share a crowd, and a past concert outside the ballpark area gave no lift [5]. It does not expect the two events to cannibalise each other. Dry, mild evening [6], so no weather adjustment.

sources.query:
SELECT day_of_week,
       ROUND(AVG(baseline_items), 1) AS baseline_items,
       COUNT(*)                      AS n_days
FROM   daily_trend
WHERE  day_of_week = 'Wednesday'
  AND  date < '2026-10-07'
GROUP  BY day_of_week;
sources.note: daily_trend rolls the sales table up per day; baseline_items is the no-event trend for that weekday.
